description: This file defines the ZoneDao interface, which extends generic DAO functionalities to handle Zone entities, including methods to list zones filtered by country and language.

classes.name: ZoneDao
classes.description: An interface for Zone Data Access Object, providing methods for querying Zone entities based on country and language filters.

methods.name: listByLanguageAndCountry
methods.description: Returns a list of zones filtered by the specified country and language.

methods.name: listByLanguage
methods.description: Returns a list of zones filtered by the specified language.
